title: Half-term hifdh check: Al-Haqqah against the rubric: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Haqqah; noon and meem recap and when letters meet
source: Written for quran/y8 lesson 24 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Half-term hifdh check rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 24. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

head: Not this
This
rows: Right hand: joy (69:19 to 24). Left hand: regret (69:25 to 29)

panels.title: Break plan
points: Al-Mulk and Al-Qalam on alternate days

keywords.def: revision of what is already memorised
the checklist used to assess recitation

questions.q: Self-check: recite 69:38 to 52 and score each rubric row.
Hifdh check: recite to the teacher one by one. While waiting, revise your manzil in breakout pairs and write your break plan.
questions.a: Teacher records rubric scores and one target per pupil in the portal.

questions.q: Extend: write your break plan on the pupil PDF.
Stretch: read Al-Ma'arij 70:1 to 10 with the mushaf and mark the rules (no new hifdh until checked).

questions.a: A) ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ. 69:30 خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ; 69:31 ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ; 69:33 إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ.

questions.q: Ramadan is the month the Qur'an was ...
Think again: Ramadan is the month of the Qur'an. How will you keep Al-Mulk, Al-Qalam and Al-Haqqah over the four-week break?
questions.a: A slice of each daily, logged, and recite in salah where possible.
